newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Tight soymeal supply in Europe boosts activity.
newsitem.headline: Tight soymeal supply in Europe boosts activity.

text.p: Tight supplies of soymeal in Europe sparked demand for nearby material this afternoon at higher levels, while other products remained fairly calm.

"There is hardly any nearby material from either north or south America or at the European crushers, while there are still a lot of operators who need to cover these positions. For some the situation could become pretty alarming," one trader said.
Dealers said there was little unsold material on vessels due to arrive in Europe, while crushers were not yet running on full capacity due to late delivery of soybeans.
